summary: A member that trims locally captures only what judging the kinds it drops reads, instead of the whole store, and plans the same drop

schema.detail: A new store table, local_trim_citations(cited, citer), with an index on citer, created on open and filled by the first local cut. No claim schema change. A local cut's staging file has its own name and identity, and a scoped_envelopes table; full captures keep theirs.

rules.detail: No retention rule change. The scoped capture's plan equals a full capture's restricted to LOCAL_TRIM_KINDS (property test).

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. An older build ignores the citation table; a cursor it left behind, or none, makes the next local cut rebuild it.

downtime.detail: None. The first local cut reads every claim once to fill the citation cache, in background pages; later cuts read one day's arrivals.

manual.detail: No manual step. A local staging file left by an older build is removed and captured again, scoped.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: local cuts capture the whole store again.
